name: Del Frisco’s Double Eagle Steakhouse
lede: On the patio of a Los Angeles steakhouse, three Platinum Electric heaters keep outdoor dining open all year, with a wireless dimmer to set the heat through the day.
data: Steakhouse dining patio in a shopping centre

hero.caption: Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric at Del Frisco’s, Century City. Bromic-published photograph (Platinum Electric Mounting Poles product page).

beats: Del Frisco’s Double Eagle Steakhouse has an outdoor dining patio at Westfield Century City, a shopping and entertainment centre in Los Angeles.
The restaurant group wanted the patio in use year-round, with guests comfortable from lunch through the evening in a Southern California climate.
Three 3400-watt Platinum Smart-Heat Electric heaters were installed on the patio. A wireless controller and wireless dimmer let staff turn the output down when less heat is needed.

products.name: Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric
products.controls: Wireless controller and wireless dimmer – output can be dimmed
